result.instructions: Tools for Connecteam, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Connecteam data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run connecteam_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run connecteam_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run connecteam_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. connecteam_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: connecteam_get_account
tools.title: Get account
tools.description: The Connecteam company this API key belongs to: company name and company id. GET /me.

tools.name: connecteam_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List employees (users): name, email, phone, user type (user/manager/owner), archived state, smart groups, custom fields and last login. Use it to map the user ids in shifts, time activities, timesheets, time off and tasks to names. Kiosk codes and device ids are never returned. GET /users/v1/users.

modified_since.description: Only users changed after this time (Unix seconds or ISO 8601 date-time with zone).

order.description: Sort order (only with a sort key).

offset.description: Index of the first result (default 0); pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: connecteam_list_schedulers
tools.title: List schedulers
tools.description: List the job schedulers (schedules) in the account with their id, name, time zone and archived state. The scheduler id is needed to list or create shifts. GET /scheduler/v1/schedulers.

tools.name: connecteam_list_shifts
tools.title: List shifts
tools.description: List shifts of one scheduler in a time window (one row per assigned user, as Connecteam's V1 endpoint returns them): title, start/end (Unix seconds), time zone, assigned user ids, open-shift spots, job, location, published state, statuses, breaks, notes and shift tasks. Filter by assigned users, job, open or published. GET /scheduler/v1/schedulers/{schedulerId}/shifts.

start_time.description: Window start: Unix seconds or ISO 8601 date-time with zone.

end_time.description: Window end: Unix seconds or ISO 8601 date-time with zone.

assigned_user_ids.description: Only shifts assigned to these user ids.

job_ids.description: Only shifts of these job ids.

is_open_shift.description: true = only open shifts, false = only assigned shifts.

is_published.description: true = only published shifts, false = only drafts.

order.description: Sort order (only with a sort key).

offset.description: Index of the first result (default 0); pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: connecteam_get_shift
tools.title: Get shift
tools.description: One shift of a scheduler by its id, with assignments, statuses, breaks, notes and tasks. GET /scheduler/v1/schedulers/{schedulerId}/shifts/{shiftId}.

tools.name: connecteam_create_shift
tools.title: Create shift
tools.description: WRITE: create ONE shift in a scheduler (one assignee or one open spot: the V1 endpoint does not create group or multi-spot shifts). By default it is created as an unpublished draft (employees see nothing). With is_published=true it is published, and Connecteam notifies the assigned users unless notify_users=false. Give a title or a job_id (Connecteam requires one). For an open shift set is_open_shift=true and leave assigned_user_ids empty. POST /scheduler/v1/schedulers/{schedulerId}/shifts.

start_time.description: Shift start: Unix seconds or ISO 8601 date-time with zone.

end_time.description: Shift end: Unix seconds or ISO 8601 date-time with zone.

title.description: Shift title (required unless job_id is given).

job_id.description: Job id (connecteam_list_jobs) to attach the shift to.

assigned_user_ids.description: The user id to assign (at most one: the V1 endpoint rejects more); empty for an open shift.

is_open_shift.description: Create an open shift with one spot that an employee can claim (default false).

require_admin_approval.description: Claiming needs admin approval (open shifts only).

timezone.description: IANA time zone, e.g. America/New_York (default: the account's time zone).

is_published.description: Publish the shift now (default false = draft).

notify_users.description: For a published shift: notify the assigned users (Connecteam default true).

note.description: A plain-text note shown on the shift.

color.description: Shift color from Connecteam's palette; defaults to the job's color (or #4B7AC5).

tools.name: connecteam_list_time_clocks
tools.title: List time clocks
tools.description: List the time clocks in the account (id, name, archived). The time clock id is needed for time activities and timesheets. GET /time-clock/v1/time-clocks.

tools.name: connecteam_list_time_activities
tools.title: List time activities
tools.description: Clock-in/clock-out records of a time clock for a date range (at most 31 days per call), grouped by user: worked shifts (start/end, job, sub-job, notes, auto clock-out), manual breaks and time off. Filter by users, jobs or activity type. GET /time-clock/v1/time-clocks/{timeClockId}/time-activities.

end_date.description: Last date (yyyy-mm-dd), at most 31 days after start_date.

user_ids.description: Only these user ids (users still assigned to the time clock).

job_ids.description: Only shifts of these job ids.

tools.name: connecteam_get_timesheet_totals
tools.title: Get timesheet totals
tools.description: Payroll-ready timesheet totals of a time clock for a date range (at most 45 days, Connecteam's limit): per user and day, total/work/paid-break/unpaid-break hours (decimal), approved/submitted/locked flags and pay items by pay rule (with pay rates when defined). Filter by users, groups, jobs or approval state. GET /time-clock/v1/time-clocks/{timeClockId}/timesheet.

end_date.description: Last date (yyyy-mm-dd), up to 23:59:59; at most 45 days after start_date.

group_ids.description: Only users in these smart group ids.

job_ids.description: Only these (parent or regular) job ids.

is_approved.description: true = approved days only, false = unapproved only.

is_submitted.description: true = submitted only, false = unsubmitted only.

is_locked.description: true = locked only, false = unlocked only.

include_plan_vs_actual.description: Add scheduled-vs-actual details per day (default false).

tools.name: connecteam_list_jobs
tools.title: List jobs
tools.description: List jobs (the work items shifts and time are tracked against): id, title, code, color, description, GPS/geofence, assigned users/groups, parent job and sub-jobs, and the schedulers/time clocks (instance ids) they belong to. GET /jobs/v1/jobs.

instance_ids.description: Only jobs of these scheduler or time clock ids.

job_ids.description: Only these job ids (a parent id also returns its sub-jobs).

order.description: Sort order (only with a sort key).

offset.description: Index of the first result (default 0); pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: connecteam_get_job
tools.title: Get job
tools.description: One job by id, with its sub-jobs, assignments and location. GET /jobs/v1/jobs/{jobId}.

tools.name: connecteam_list_time_off_policy_types
tools.title: List time-off policy types
tools.description: List time-off policy types (e.g. Vacation, Sick) and their policies with unit (hours/days) and accrual type. Needs the HR & Skills hub. GET /time-off/v1/policy-types.

tools.name: connecteam_list_time_off_requests
tools.title: List time-off requests
tools.description: List time-off requests overlapping a date range (at most 365 days): user, policy type, dates/times, all-day flag, status (approved/pending/denied), notes, approving manager and, for approved requests, the amount deducted. Connecteam returns only approved requests unless statuses is given. Needs the HR & Skills hub. GET /time-off/v1/requests.

end_date.description: Range end (yyyy-mm-dd), inclusive; at most 365 days after start_date.

offset.description: Index of the first result (default 0); pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: connecteam_list_task_boards
tools.title: List task boards
tools.description: List the quick-task boards in the account (id, name, archived). The board id is needed to list or create tasks. GET /tasks/v1/taskboards.

tools.name: connecteam_list_tasks
tools.title: List tasks
tools.description: List tasks on a task board: title, assigned user ids, status (draft/published/completed), start and due time (Unix seconds), labels, sub-tasks and description. Filter by status, users, labels or task ids. GET /tasks/v1/taskboards/{taskBoardId}/tasks.

user_ids.description: Only tasks assigned to these user ids (group tasks are included).

label_ids.description: Only tasks carrying these label ids.

offset.description: Index of the first result (default 0); pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: connecteam_list_task_labels
tools.title: List task labels
tools.description: List the labels of a task board (id, name, color), for filtering tasks or labelling a new one. GET /tasks/v1/taskboards/{taskBoardId}/labels.

title.description: Only the label with this name.

offset.description: Index of the first result (default 0); pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: connecteam_create_task
tools.title: Create task
tools.description: WRITE: create one quick task on a task board for the given users. status 'draft' keeps it hidden; 'published' sends it to the assignees' apps. Several user ids make one group task. POST /tasks/v1/taskboards/{taskBoardId}/tasks.

user_ids.description: Assignee user ids (several = one group task).

status.description: 'draft' (not visible to employees) or 'published' (sent to the assignees).

start_time.description: Start: Unix seconds or ISO 8601 date-time with zone.

due_date.description: Due: Unix seconds or ISO 8601 date-time with zone.

tools.name: connecteam_list_forms
tools.title: List forms
tools.description: List forms (checklists, inspections, reports) with their questions. Filter by name or creation date. GET /forms/v1/forms.

offset.description: Index of the first result (default 0); pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: connecteam_list_form_submissions
tools.title: List form submissions
tools.description: List the submissions of one form: who submitted and when, the answers and the manager fields (status, owner, notes). Filter by submitting users and time window. GET /forms/v1/forms/{formId}/form-submissions.

user_ids.description: Only submissions by these user ids.

submitted_from.description: Submitted at or after: Unix seconds or ISO 8601 date-time with zone.

submitted_to.description: Submitted at or before: Unix seconds or ISO 8601 date-time with zone.

offset.description: Index of the first result (default 0); pass the previous reply's next_offset.
